description: Scrape Coupang best sellers by category, Coupang keyword suggestions, or the Coupang category tree. Product records include current and original price, unit price, coupon, rating, Rocket delivery, and a category breadcrumb. Set includeSubcategories to walk child best100 pages until Maximum products is reached. No proxy, cookies, or login required for these modes.

category.description: Coupang best-seller category. Each category page returns up to 30 products; enable Include subcategories to continue into child pages until Maximum products is reached.
category.sectionDescription: Pick a category. Coupang's best100 page exposes 30 products per category.
category.title: Category

categoryId.description: Optional numeric Coupang best100 category ID or /np/categories/ URL. Overrides the category dropdown.
categoryId.title: Advanced category ID

includeSubcategories.description: When true, after the selected category page is fetched, also fetch its child category best-seller pages until Maximum products is reached. Default false; small maxItems values usually need no child pages.
includeSubcategories.title: Include subcategories

maxCategories.description: Maximum category nodes to return from the Coupang category tree.
maxCategories.sectionDescription: The Coupang category tree with IDs and URLs. No proxy required.
maxCategories.title: Maximum categories

maxItems.description: Maximum number of best-seller products to return. A single best100 page has at most 30; set includeSubcategories=true to continue into child pages, or use category=all.
maxItems.sectionDescription: The daily test uses 3 products. Coupang best100 exposes 30 products per category.
maxItems.title: Maximum products

maxPrice.description: Only return products at or below this price in Korean won.
maxPrice.title: Maximum price (KRW)

maxSuggestions.description: Maximum suggestions to return per keyword.
maxSuggestions.title: Suggestions per keyword

minPrice.description: Only return products at or above this price in Korean won.
minPrice.sectionDescription: Optional filters applied to the best-seller products.
minPrice.title: Minimum price (KRW)

minRating.description: Keep only products rated at least this many stars. Products without a rating are skipped.
minRating.title: Minimum rating

mode.description: What to collect. Best sellers returns products with price, unit price, coupon, rating, Rocket delivery, and category breadcrumb; keyword suggestions and the category tree return discovery data. Search, product details, and reviews need a Korean residential proxy and are unavailable unless that connection is enabled.
enumTitles: Search by keyword (unavailable without a proxy)
Category products (legacy alias for best sellers)
mode.title: Mode

rocketOnly.description: Keep only products with Coupang's Rocket delivery badge.
rocketOnly.title: Rocket delivery only

searchQueries.description: Keywords for keyword suggestions (mode=keywordSuggestions). Korean or English.
searchQueries.sectionDescription: Coupang's own search-box suggestions. No proxy required.
searchQueries.title: Keywords
